name: birkin-mnemosyne MCP
description: Local Markdown memory with multilingual BM25 retrieval, reviewed against birkin-mnemosyne 0.7.0. Reviews note creation, append/replace, archival, restoration, curation, review answers and undo, and INDEX route writes and splits through mnemosyne-mcp. Recall inherits Guard policy; reading a note records usage, and indexing may write cache files. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: Configure uvx with --from birkin-mnemosyne[mcp], then mnemosyne-mcp --vault PATH; the console script differs from the package name.
Inspect memory_search, memory_list, or memory_curation_catalog before approving note changes; memory_get_note also persists usage history.
Use memory_remember mode=create to avoid overwriting notes; replace requires expected_version from a fresh memory_get_note.
Preview memory_forget with confirm=false and memory_curate with apply=false before approving archival or curation.
Use an explicitly selected vault with only intended notes; its path is not an OS sandbox, and existing symlinks can expose other files.
Check or restrict MNEMOSYNE_IDENTITY_ROOT / --identity-root too: memory_identity_read and memory_startup_read can read files under that separate root outside the selected vault.
Launch exactly birkin-mnemosyne[mcp] (optionally ==VERSION). Other spellings such as [mcp,semantic], birkin_mnemosyne or no extra are outside this entry and keep your ordinary Guard policy.
